description: This file manages Apple Push Notification Service (APNs) registration, authentication, and push notification sending, supporting both direct and relay transports. It includes functions for registration, token validation, environment resolution, and push message creation.

methods.name: resolveApnsRegistrationPath
methods.description: Constructs the file path for storing APNs registration data based on optional base directory.

methods.name: normalizeNodeId
methods.description: Trims whitespace from node ID string.

methods.name: isValidNodeId
methods.description: Checks if node ID length is within allowed maximum.

methods.name: normalizeApnsToken
methods.description: Cleans and lowercases APNs token string.

methods.name: normalizeRelayHandle
methods.description: Trims whitespace from relay handle string.

methods.name: normalizeInstallationId
methods.description: Trims whitespace from installation ID string.

methods.name: validateRelayIdentifier
methods.description: Validates relay handle, sendGrant, or installationId for presence, length, and character validity.

methods.name: normalizeTopic
methods.description: Trims whitespace from topic string.

methods.name: isValidTopic
methods.description: Checks if topic length is within allowed maximum.

methods.name: normalizeTokenDebugSuffix
methods.description: Normalizes optional token debug suffix to lowercase alphanumeric, last 8 characters.

methods.name: isLikelyApnsToken
methods.description: Checks if token string matches expected hex pattern and length.

methods.name: parseReason
methods.description: Parses reason string from JSON response body, with fallback to raw trimmed string.

methods.name: toBase64UrlBytes
methods.description: Converts byte array to URL-safe base64 string.

methods.name: toBase64UrlJson
methods.description: Converts JSON object to URL-safe base64 string.

methods.name: getJwtCacheKey
methods.description: Generates cache key for JWT based on teamId, keyId, and privateKey hash.

methods.name: getApnsBearerToken
methods.description: Generates or retrieves cached JWT bearer token for APNs authentication.

methods.name: normalizePrivateKey
methods.description: Replaces escaped newlines with actual newlines in private key string.

methods.name: normalizeNonEmptyString
methods.description: Trims string or returns null if empty.

methods.name: normalizeDistribution
methods.description: Normalizes distribution string to 'official' or null.

methods.name: normalizeDirectRegistration
methods.description: Normalizes and validates direct registration record.

methods.name: normalizeRelayRegistration
methods.description: Normalizes and validates relay registration record.

methods.name: normalizeStoredRegistration
methods.description: Determines registration type and normalizes stored record.

methods.name: loadRegistrationsState
methods.description: Loads registration state from JSON file, normalizing entries.

methods.name: persistRegistrationsState
methods.description: Saves registration state to JSON file atomically.

methods.name: normalizeApnsEnvironment
methods.description: Converts environment string to 'sandbox' or 'production' or null.

methods.name: registerApnsRegistration
methods.description: Registers or updates an APNs registration, handling both direct and relay types.

methods.name: registerApnsToken
methods.description: Convenience function to register a direct APNs token.

methods.name: loadApnsRegistration
methods.description: Loads registration for a given node ID.

methods.name: clearApnsRegistration
methods.description: Removes registration for a given node ID.

methods.name: isSameApnsRegistration
methods.description: Checks if two registrations are equivalent.

methods.name: clearApnsRegistrationIfCurrent
methods.description: Removes registration if it matches the current stored registration.

methods.name: shouldInvalidateApnsRegistration
methods.description: Determines if a response indicates registration should be invalidated.

methods.name: shouldClearStoredApnsRegistration
methods.description: Checks if registration should be cleared based on response and environment override.

methods.name: resolveApnsAuthConfigFromEnv
methods.description: Resolves APNs auth config from environment variables, reading private key from inline or file.

methods.name: sendApnsRequest
methods.description: Sends an APNs push notification request over HTTP/2.

methods.name: resolveApnsTimeoutMs
methods.description: Determines effective timeout for APNs request.

methods.name: resolveDirectSendContext
methods.description: Prepares token, topic, environment, and bearer token for direct push.

methods.name: toPushMetadata
methods.description: Creates metadata object for push notification.

methods.name: resolveRegistrationDebugSuffix
methods.description: Generates debug suffix for registration based on transport type.

methods.name: toPushResult
methods.description: Converts response into standardized push result object.

methods.name: sendDirectApnsPush
methods.description: Sends push notification directly to APNs.

methods.name: sendRelayApnsPush
methods.description: Sends push notification via relay.

methods.name: createAlertPayload
methods.description: Creates payload for alert notification.

methods.name: createBackgroundPayload
methods.description: Creates payload for background wake notification.

methods.name: sendApnsAlert
methods.description: High-level function to send alert notification, handling direct or relay.

methods.name: sendApnsBackgroundWake
methods.description: High-level function to send background wake notification, handling direct or relay.
